items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She played with – she played in a band with Joe Henderson for a while.

ctx.x: I said, Lord, have mercy. But she can play that bass, baby. At least she played it that night.
She played with – she played in a band with Joe Henderson for a while.

Oh really. Yeah, well, she – I remember her, and I remember several of the saxophone players. Man, they come out of the woodwork, and they’re so glad to get up on that stage, because, you know, Sweet Basil is – they was kind of tight. Well, all the New York clubs, they sure didn’t want no cat from Chicago comes in and start some stuff, jam sessions.
